input.summary: Add a 30-day non-renewal notice right to the auto-renewal sentence
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added an express non-renewal right on thirty (30) days' notice before the end of each term, since today the only exit from an automatic renewal is ninety (90) days' notice, which is longer than our 30-day preferred (60-day fallback) window. We can live with 60 days if that works better for you.

ops.oldText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
ops.newText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless either Party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term, or unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
